FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
TechWise Solutions specializes in providing comprehensive computer and technology services, including remote IT support, system integration, and network management for small to medium-sized enterprises. We focus on delivering tailored software development and application programming solutions that enhance operational efficiency. Our team of certified professionals also offers managed services such as cloud computing support, cybersecurity assessments, and data backup solutions, ensuring our clients' technological environments are secure and efficient.

We prioritize maintaining compliance with all applicable data protection regulations, including GDPR and CCPA, while implementing rigorous data handling and security policies to mitigate risks associated with data breaches. Our operations are conducted from a centralized office environment, which minimizes on-site exposure and ensures a controlled setting for all client interactions. As we do not engage in manufacturing or providing IT services to high-risk industries, we maintain a solid reputation for reliability and professionalism in the ever-evolving technology landscape.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities involving the operation of production-type machinery with our computers, nor do we manufacture or assemble custom computer hardware. Additionally, we maintain current cyber liability insurance that covers data breach notification and remediation expenses, and we confirm that we have no history of unresolved regulatory violations or data breaches.
